summary: The cap formula is exact on all three branches and at both transitions; strict failure correctly forces both side parameters above 1 and hence -1<c<1. The centroid argument, sheared long-edge containment, separate root-exterior leakage bounds, and both h-range contradictions are logically valid with the stated strictness. All support, cap-transition, zero-area boundary, and h=1/5 cases are retained.
